ops.old: Beer-battered flathead, thick chips, tartare and a cabbage slaw. Bake the chips at 220C for 25 minutes. Mix the mayonnaise with chopped capers, gherkins and a squeeze of lemon for the tartare. Toss the shredded cabbage and grated carrot with 2 tbsp of it. Whisk 120g of the flour with the baking powder and lager until smooth. Heat the oil to 180C. Dust the fish in the rest of the flour, dip in the batter and fry in batches for 4 minutes until golden. Serve with the chips, tartare, slaw and lemon wedges.
